title: Asynchronous Verified Semantic Caching for Tiered LLM Architectures

live_model.evidence: "SemCacheSearchQueries equivalence classes are constructed via a union-find pass guided by an LLM judge (GPT-4.1-nano)" -- attributed to the cited vCache benchmark, not run by these authors

prompt.note: The paper explicitly states it does not run an LLM judge in its own simulation loop; GPT-4.1-nano's role is inherited from a cited benchmark's construction.

claim.metric: none (GPT-4.1-nano is cited as the judge used to build a benchmark, not run by this paper)

data.source: SemCacheLMArena and SemCacheSearchQueries benchmarks (Schroeder et al. 2025, vCache)

notes: This paper's own headline policy results are explicitly judge-agnostic (oracle from labeled equivalence classes); the only other LLM judge they run themselves is Claude Opus 4.5 on a 100-pair audit sample, which is out of scope.
